steps.name: plyfile_check
steps.cmd:
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import numpy as np, plyfile, tempfile, os
a = np.zeros(4, dtype=[('"'"'x'"'"', '"'"'f4'"'"'), ('"'"'y'"'"', '"'"'f4'"'"')]); a['"'"'x'"'"'] = [1, 2, 3, 4]
p = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), '"'"'t.ply'"'"')
plyfile.PlyData([plyfile.PlyElement.describe(a, '"'"'vertex'"'"')]).write(p)
b = plyfile.PlyData.read(p)['"'"'vertex'"'"']['"'"'x'"'"']
assert list(b) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
print('"'"'PLYFILE_OK'"'"', getattr(plyfile, '"'"'__version__'"'"', '"'"''"'"'))
'
